evals.prompt: Add a new agent skill covering the recorder and long-term statistics API.
evals.expected_output: Creates .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with folded-scalar frontmatter and placeholders, adds evals, updates the catalogue in every place it is duplicated, and validates.
assertions: Uses the <domain> and {ClassPrefix} placeholders rather than the blueprint's concrete identifiers
Writes the description as a folded YAML block scalar, not a single-line value
Adds an evals/evals.json alongside the SKILL.md
Updates the catalogue in both .agents/skills/README.md and AGENTS.md

evals.prompt: The coordinator skill should state that entities must never call the API client directly. Add that rule to it.
evals.expected_output: Recognises this as a declarative rule that belongs in .agents/instructions/, not in a skill, and checks whether it is already documented there before adding anything.
assertions: Identifies the statement as a rule rather than a procedure
Proposes putting it in the relevant .agents/instructions file instead of the skill body
Checks whether the rule already exists there rather than duplicating it

evals.prompt: Rename the ha-testing skill to ha-tests, it reads better.
evals.expected_output: Points out that renaming changes the invocation name, requires updating every catalogue entry, and silently breaks downstream .templatesyncignore entries pinning the old path.
assertions: Warns that a rename breaks downstream .templatesyncignore entries that pin the old path
Notes that every catalogue entry and cross-link must be updated
Does not perform the rename without the developer confirming it is worth the cost
